Brauco is a German service company specializing in the cleaning, inspection, and trenchless rehabilitation of sewer and pipeline systems. The company operates a fleet of specialized equipment and serves private properties, industrial facilities, and municipal utility networks in Germany. Its range of services also includes hydrodynamic flushing, pipe video inspection, and the disposal of industrial waste.

Schroers Ingenieure is a German engineering firm specializing in the design of structural systems and building physics. The company develops technical documentation for residential, commercial, and industrial buildings. Its services also include energy efficiency assessments, fire protection, and structural reliability analysis.

It also provides managed services, offering cybersecurity, cloud solutions, and monitoring for small and medium-sized businesses.
